subheadTestimonies: What God is doing across every nation.
emptyTestimoniesBody: No testimonies here yet. Tell the family what God has done.
emptyPrayerBody: When someone asks for prayer, you'll find them here.
gateTitle: Sign in to say Glory to God
gateBody: Join the family to react, share testimonies, RSVP, and track your rhythm.
goneBody: It may have been removed or taken down by the person who shared it.
prayingWithYou: The family is praying with you.
gatePrayerTitle: Sign in to pray with them
gateComposeTitle: Sign in to share with the family
mapSummary: A world map with {{branches}} church locations and {{count}} recent testimonies across nations.
mapSheetHandle: Recent family activity, swipe to expand or collapse
prayCommitExplain: Tap when you commit to pray. We'll gently remind you, and you can mark 'I prayed' once you have.
composeTestimonyPlaceholder: What has God done? Tell the family.
composePrayerPlaceholder: What would you like the family to pray for?
photoErrorGeneric: We couldn't add that photo. Check your connection and try again, or share without it.
photoErrorPermission: We need permission to open your photos. You can allow it in Settings, or share without a photo.
photoErrorTooLarge: That photo is a little too large to send. Please choose a smaller one.
photoErrorNotAnImage: That file doesn't look like a photo. Please choose a picture from your library.
composeBodyTooLong: That's a little long. Please shorten it to {{max}} characters.
consentLeadTestimony: A quick note on how your testimony is shared.
consentLeadPrayer: A quick note on how your prayer request is shared.
consentPoint1Body: Once approved, it appears in the AGBC feed across every nation.
consentPoint2Body: A leader from your branch reviews it before it goes public.
consentPoint3Body: Edit or delete it anytime from My posts.
consentPhotoBody: If someone can be recognised in it, please ask them first. Never share a photo of a child without their parent's consent.
consentAgree: I agree to share this publicly.
pendingBodyTestimony: A leader will review your testimony shortly. You'll be notified the moment it's live for the family to see.
pendingBodyPrayer: A leader will review your request shortly. You'll be notified the moment it's live for the family to see.
errorLimit: You've shared a lot with the family today. Please come back tomorrow to share more.
errorConsentStale: Please update the app to share: the wording you agree to has changed.
errorOffline: That didn't send. Your draft is saved, so try again when you're back online.
errorGeneric: That didn't send. Your draft is safe, so please try again.

myPosts.title: My posts
myPosts.removedBody: Removed by a leader after review. If you believe this is a mistake, contact your branch leader.
myPosts.emptyBody: What you share with the family, and how it is getting on, will live here.
myPosts.guestTitle: Sign in to see your posts
myPosts.guestBody: Your testimonies and prayer requests, and how each one is getting on, live here once you are signed in.

actions.editSub: Editing sends this back for review
actions.gateReportTitle: Sign in to report this post
actions.gateBlockTitle: Sign in to block this member
actions.gateBody: Reports and blocks belong to your account, so a leader knows a real person raised it.

report.title: Report this post

at_risk.title: Someone may be at risk
at_risk.body: Abuse, self-harm, or a child in danger. This one reaches a leader first.

private_details.title: Private details about someone
private_details.body: A name, a photo, or something about their health that was not theirs to share.

hurtful.title: Hurtful or abusive
hurtful.body: Words that attack or shame a person.

not_for_this_space.title: Not for this space
not_for_this_space.body: Selling something, spam, or nothing to do with the church.

report.thanks: Thank you. A leader will look at this.
report.failed: That did not send. Please try again.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.body: You will not see each other's testimonies or prayers, and they are not told. You can undo this in Settings under Blocked members. If you want a leader to look at this post, report it instead.
block.failed: That did not work. Please try again.

deletePost.bodyTestimony: It will be removed from the family feed and from My posts. This cannot be undone, and the Glory others gave it goes with it.
deletePost.bodyPrayer: It will be removed from the family feed and from My posts. This cannot be undone.
deletePost.failed: That did not work. Please try again.
